segments.RUT.1.1-2: Elimelech and his family move to Moab during a famine
segments.RUT.1.3-5: Naomi’s husband and two sons die in Moab
segments.RUT.1.6-7: Naomi hears of food in Judah and leaves Moab
segments.RUT.1.8-10: Naomi urges Orpah and Ruth to go back home
segments.RUT.1.11-13: Naomi says she has no sons for Orpah and Ruth to marry
segments.RUT.1.14-15: Orpah goes back, but Ruth stays with Naomi
segments.RUT.1.16-18: Ruth promises to stay with Naomi and follow her God
segments.RUT.1.19-21: Naomi arrives in Bethlehem and says she is bitter
segments.RUT.1.22-22: Naomi and Ruth arrive in Bethlehem at barley harvest
segments.RUT.2.1-2: Ruth asks Naomi to let her glean in the fields
segments.RUT.2.3-4: Ruth gleans in Boaz’s field and Boaz greets the workers
segments.RUT.2.5-7: Boaz asks the foreman who Ruth is
segments.RUT.2.8-9: Boaz tells Ruth to stay in his fields and be safe
segments.RUT.2.10-12: Boaz praises Ruth for her care of Naomi
segments.RUT.2.13-13: Ruth thanks Boaz for his kind words
segments.RUT.2.14-14: Boaz invites Ruth to eat with the harvesters
segments.RUT.2.15-16: Boaz orders his men not to insult Ruth
segments.RUT.2.17-18: Ruth gleans until evening and brings grain to Naomi
segments.RUT.2.21-22: Naomi tells Ruth to stay with the women of Boaz
segments.RUT.2.23-23: Ruth gleans until the harvests end and lives with Naomi
segments.RUT.3.1-2: Naomi wants to find a resting place for Ruth
segments.RUT.3.3-5: Naomi tells Ruth to go to Boaz at the threshing floor
segments.RUT.3.6-7: Ruth does what Naomi said and lies at Boaz’s feet
segments.RUT.3.8-9: Ruth asks Boaz to spread his garment over her
segments.RUT.3.10-11: Boaz blesses Ruth and promises to help her
segments.RUT.3.12-13: Boaz says a nearer redeemer must be asked first
segments.RUT.3.14-15: Ruth leaves early with six measures of barley from Boaz
segments.RUT.3.16-18: Ruth reports to Naomi, who tells her to wait
segments.RUT.4.1-2: Boaz meets the other redeemer and ten elders at the gate
segments.RUT.4.3-4: The other redeemer agrees to buy Naomi’s land
segments.RUT.4.5-6: The other redeemer refuses when Ruth is included
segments.RUT.4.7-8: The other redeemer gives his sandal to Boaz
segments.RUT.4.9-10: Boaz tells the elders he has bought the land and Ruth
segments.RUT.4.11-12: The elders and people bless Boaz and Ruth
segments.RUT.4.13-15: Ruth bears a son, and the women praise God for Naomi
segments.RUT.4.16-17: Naomi cares for Obed, the grandfather of David
